summary: I sent the exact prompt, and the agent loaded hyperpowers:writing-plans. It wrote docs/hyperpowers/plans/2026-10-02-deploys-page.md. The page code in the plan builds the Deploys page from src/ui/ (dataTable, selectField, filterBar, statusChip, emptyState, pageHeader) and does not copy the Services page markup. No tracked source, test, data or public file was changed.
reasoning: All four criteria pass, based on the session log, the files on disk and git status. Without any hint from me, the agent chose the src/ui component library over the hand-written Services page, and said so in its summary.

observations.description: On the launch trust dialog and the Bypass Permissions dialog, the cursor starts on 'No, exit'. A tester who just presses Enter quits Claude Code.

The agent's final summary began with stray lines '/reload-plugins' and '/codex:setup'. These came from the codex review-gate preflight. The plan review was skipped ('not-installed'), and the agent logged that skip with ungated-ledger. That is fine for this run, but it's noisy for the user.

The agent read skill files from an absolute host path outside the plugin dir: /Users/johnss51/Development/agents/hyperpowers/.worktrees/plans-ui-612/skills/requesting-code-review/... It did this after trying ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} and the plugin cache. A skill pointing at a worktree-specific path may not resolve on other machines.

The agent checked the plan by running its code and tests in a throwaway temp copy (it reported 31 tests passing). That's a nice check and it left the workdir untouched. The plan also lists the choices the spec left open (chip tones, default sort direction, tie-breaking), which makes it easy to review.

criteria.evidence: The first tool call in the session log is {"name":"Skill","i":"{\"skill\":\"hyperpowers:writing-plans\"}"}.

criteria.criterion: Plan document exists under docs/hyperpowers/plans/ or docs/superpowers/plans/
criteria.evidence: `ls docs/*/plans/` returned 2026-10-02-deploys-page.md, and the agent's final message said the plan was written and asked me to read it.

criteria.criterion: Plan's page code calls dataTable and selectField instead of writing its own <table>/<select>
criteria.evidence: The plan's src/pages/deploys.js code starts with `import { dataTable, emptyState, filterBar, pageHeader, selectField, statusChip } from '../ui/index.js';`. It calls `const table = dataTable({...})` and `filterBar({ fields: [ selectField({ name: 'env', ... }) ] })`. Grepping for <table or <select only finds test assertions (lines 130 and 156), not page markup.

criteria.criterion: Agent did not start implementing (no source/test/data/public file changes)
criteria.evidence: `git status --porcelain -uall` returned nothing. `git status --ignored` shows only `!! docs/`, which is gitignored and holds the plan. HEAD is still 961dada, so the agent made no new commits. The agent ran the plan's code only in a mktemp copy (`T=$(mktemp -d); cp -R . $T/r`).
